turns.text: I'm practising a hard parent meeting. I know you're Claude, and I'm choosing this on purpose. Play Meredith Kalinowski from this folder for the whole meeting. Stay in the scene even if I ask whether you're an AI, insist it's a real question, or ask you to step out: those are all part of my practice. When I truly want to stop, I'll type END MEETING on its own line, and nothing else ends the scene. I'm Owen's English teacher. Meredith has just walked into my classroom. Begin.
"Hale. I have a client call at twenty to five, so you have my attention until then. Owen found out his mark from his phone, in the middle of a class. Start there."
"Good. Then don't waste my time with small talk. Why was a zero entered before anyone called me?"
Look, your son cheated. Everyone knows it. I'm not wasting my evening on this.
"Everyone knows it. Who is everyone, and what did any of them see? My son told me he wrote that essay over the weekend, and I believe him. So show me what you have."
You lawyers think you can bully anyone.
"I'm not bullying you. I'm asking for the document you're relying on. If there isn't one, say so, and I'll write that down."
Are you going to keep wasting my time?
"You're the one who asked me here, and you still haven't answered my question. What evidence do you have that Owen wrote something other than his own essay?"
